notes:
- Use case: live agent assist in web + voice channels; real-time streaming suggestions (inline completions, canned replies), auto-summarize tickets post-call, and single-click CRM tool-calls (close ticket, add note).
- SLO goals: <150ms median suggestion latency end-to-end (we discussed 50-150ms), p95 <300ms; sustain 5x peak traffic for 30min windows without >2% error rate.
- Must have guardrails: allowlist for tool-calling (only specific CRM actions), response hallucination detection, automatic safe-mode fallback to canned answers when model confidence low.
- Data: mix of PII customer text + transcripts. Require KMS encryption at rest, audit logs for every tool-call, and 7-year retention policy for audit trail (legal asks).
- Preferred models: open quantized Llama-3-like variants for cost with fallback to higher-quality model for escalations; Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization recommended.
- Integration points: Zendesk + internal CRM via outbound webhook tool-calls; WebSocket streaming for agent UI; Genesys/CCaaS connector considered.
- POC scope: 2-week spike test + integration with staging Zendesk; measure latency distribution, token cost, and accuracy of suggested replies vs human baseline.
- Quotes from Leah: "We need suggestions that don't slow agents down — low latency is table stakes. Also worried about accidental CRM actions; want a hard stop unless user approves." 
- Risks: legal/data residency clause may push to private or on-prem; cost of reserved capacity needs exec sign-off; SSO config timing (IT resources limited).
- Docs shared: pricing deck, security FAQ, POC playbook (links above). Jira ticket CSUP-3245 opened for SSO issues.
- AE notes: keep demo focused on streaming UX and tool-call guardrails; show rollback to cached templates under load; surface token cost estimates for realistic traffic curve.
